integrity: The graph construction and density statement are cited primary-source premises; the killed-transfer BV argument proves the arclength conclusion. Exact derivative checks verify the quadrant images but not the all-parameter graph census.
scientific_limitations: Arclength on the constructed invariant graph only; no ambient planar-area conclusion, exceptional-set dimension or uniform escape rate. Depends on published finite-graph and dense-preimage results.
title: Full arclength absorption by flat branches for every parameter in a planar absolute-value family
